title: Data sources
noCredNote_one: {{count}} data source has no credential and collects nothing
noCredNote_other: {{count}} data sources have no credentials and collect nothing

empty.title: No data sources
empty.noSource: No data source connected yet. Every list page stays empty until the first one is configured.

inheritedHint: GKE authenticates via the bound cloud account service account; no kubeconfig needed
noCredNote: {{count}} data sources really have no credential and cannot collect anything
notConfiguredOkHint: This kind of source needs no credential here: K8s clusters use an in-cluster ServiceAccount or inherit the cloud account, and internal Prometheus/Loki usually have no auth

typeHint.gke: GKE cluster — authenticates via the bound cloud account’s service account; no kubeconfig stored
typeHint.generic: Generic K8s cluster (self-hosted / k3s) — authenticates with the kubeconfig stored here, a different mechanism from GKE
typeHint.prometheus: Prometheus-compatible endpoint (incl. VictoriaMetrics). Queried on demand, so having no sync record is normal
typeHint.loki: Loki log endpoint. Queried on demand, so having no sync record is normal
typeHint.gcp: GCP cloud account. SA keys are configured per project, not per account — GCP grants permissions per project
